title: We Did Math DCA Refused To Publish

intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon detective chicken character with a magnifying glass standing over a chalkboard full of equations, crime-scene tape strung everywhere, spotlighted on a stand-up stage.

outro_meme.prompt: The same detective chicken giving a triumphant thumbs up, holding a stack of receipts, pointing toward a glowing 'READ MORE' sign.

sources.fact: DCA's own 20-year figures show grower contract income (total pool) up 27.4% inflation-adjusted while grower count fell 36.8% to 1,225 — dividing one by the other implies the average remaining grower's real share roughly doubled, a calculation DCA itself never publishes.

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: Kai, I did some math DCA ain't never gonna do themselves.

screen.prompt: A cartoon detective Nate character with a magnifying glass and a chalkboard covered in scribbled equations, crime-scene tape everywhere labeled 'MATH.'

lines.voice_instructions: Channel Richard Pryor-style stand-up energy: exasperated, escalating, physically reactive delivery — real gasps, real disbelief, voice cracking on the big reveal. This is two friends losing it together over something absurd, not a news broadcast. Real cursing where the line calls for it, land every word of it like a punchline, not a warning label.
